description: ISO condition-monitoring standards as graph nodes (ISO.*). ISO.Severity: ISO 20816-3 broadband vibration-severity (zone A/B/C/D) with unit-tagged, refuse-not-guess inputs.

subPlugins.description: ISO 20816-3 broadband velocity-RMS severity (zone A/B/C/D) over 10-1000 Hz. Reads the signal's unit tag and refuses on undeclared units, undersampling, or out-of-scope machines.
